description:
Introducing the forthcoming album “Dreamweavers”, the magic trio Mark de Clive-Lowe, Andrea Lombardini and Tommaso Cappellato deliver two extra bonus tracks on a limited “Aqua-marine” coloured 7inch beauty.
“Masina’s World” and “Mizugaki” totally reflect the vibe of the soon to come LP and will have Electronic/Jazz heads impatient for more.
credits:
Mark de Clive-Lowe - piano, fender rhodes, synths
Andrea Lombardini - electric and double bass
Tommaso Cappellato - drums and percussion

Recorded August 6-8 2019 at Basement Studio, Vicenza - Italy
Mixed by Antonio Nappo at Studio Q - Milano, Italy
Mastered by Marco Zangirolami
Produced by Andrea Lombardini & Tommaso Cappellato
Pressed and Distributed by Mother Tongue, Verona - Italy
